The pytest plugin that provides the `agentic_hil` fixture is defined in **`src/agentic_hil/pytest_plugin.py`**.

This module:
- Registers CLI options and ini settings via `pytest_addoption` (adds `--agentic-hil-config` option and `agentic_hil_config` ini setting).
- Defines a session-scoped `agentic_hil_config` fixture that loads the authoritative configuration (via `load_authoritative_config`).
- Defines a session-scoped `_agentic_hil_service` fixture that builds an `AgenticHILToolService` (from `agentic_hil.tools`) using that config.
- The `agentic_hil` fixture itself (built on top of `_agentic_hil_service`) exposes a `.call(name, arguments)` interface so tests can drive the same tools as the CLI/MCP server, per the description in `src/agentic_hil/skills/agentic-hil/SKILL.md`.

The plugin is registered as an installed pytest plugin for the `agentic-hil` distribution (entry point), making the `agentic_hil` fixture available to any test session that has the package installed.
